listing.name: Secrets of the Frontier
listing.summary: Dance amongst the void. Discover the secrets of the frontier.
listing.aiSummary: Adds narrative content centered around Domain-era AI experiments, new tactical combat objectives and environments, and a station-building mechanic.

description:
Secrets of the Frontier requires LunaLib as of 0.14.5!!!

Secrets of the Frontier is a mod focused on narrative content around several Domain-era AI experiments conducted in the Persean Sector. It also adds additional content to the game's tactical layer through more scenic environments and new combat objectives, and adds a simple station-building mechanic to the campaign layer.

This mod is still in active development, and is not complete in terms of features or narrative. It's comprised of several modules that can be individually toggled on or off. The mod is best experienced on a normally-sized sector without Nexerelin's random sector option.

Click the big banner to download. Requires LazyLib, GraphicsLib, MagicLib AND LunaLib.

All of the current modules in the prerelease can be added midway through a campaign and still function (encounters typically generated at the start of the campaign will spawn in immediately)

Turning off Watcher Beyond the Walls mid-campaign may cause issues.

If you find any bugs, do mention them to me!

Secrets of the Frontier is currently my main modding focus but despite that, a full release is most likely far off. Teasers may end up posted here.

Required mods:

LazyLib

GraphicsLib

MagicLib

LunaLib

Highly recommended mods:

Combat Chatter

- this mod's unique officers come with special chatter!

Some add-ons and crossovers:

Second-in-Command

- by Lukas04, which combined with SotF allow you to employ Sierra as an executive officer to gain fleet-wide boons of witchcraft.

Dustkeeper XO

- by shmone-else, which adds a Dustkeeper aptitude to Second-in-Command

Secrets Of The Frontier - Bonus Combat Objectives

- by NikoTheGuyDude, which adds several new objectives to the Tactical Expansion module of SotF

Random Assortment of Things

- by Lukas04, a customizable megamod that also adds a new ship for Sierra with its Abyssal Depths module

Phillip Andrada Gas Station Manager

- by WMGreywind, a high-effort Diktat meme overhaul with unique Sierra interactions and an Askonia mini-quest involving a SotF character

Modules

Secrets of the Frontier comes as several modules that can be individually turned on and off, listed:

Watcher Beyond The Walls:

Adds narrative content including quests and special encounters centered around a set of Domain-era AI projects.

- Make contact with the Dustkeeper Contingency, a sect of rogue guardians trying to save humanity.

- Befriend Sierra, an interdimensional AI companion with a penchant for music and dance.

- Play "The Haunted", a custom start where you're a former pirate warlord with gnawing guilt and a relentless pursuer

- Play "Child of the Lake", a custom start who you are served dutifully by an occult technological heirloom who grants you abilities almost like black magic

- Currently features the following quests/encounters:

Spoiler- A Promise

- A Memory

- Wayward Star

- Hope for Hallowhall

- Legacy of Hypnos

- Light of the Lake (Haunted start only)

[close]

Tactical Expansion:

Enhances the combat layer of the game.

-Adds two new objective types, the Emplacement/Siegeworks Uplink and Hyperwave Transmitter, alongside their Remnant versions.

-Visual enhancements to battlefield backgrounds, including visible jump-points and multiple planets.

-Context-based battle generation. Some aspects of combat such as objectives change depending on where you're fighting.

Frontier Development:

Adds a constructable orbital habitat to stable locations that grants a hazard reduction to in-system colonies.

-Can be upgraded into an outpost, which acts as a low-hazard colony but loses the hazard reduction and has a soft-cap on its growth.

Changelog:

SpoilerVersion 0.15.1:

- Added "Legacy of Hypnos" quest, leading player to existing Hypnos content. Currently obtained from friendly rep Inadvertent (for now)

- Drone launchers now have a cap of 2/6/6 drones depending on size, beyond which they become unable to fire until existing drones fired by the launcher have been destroyed

- Barb mount: increased ammo (2 > 4), increased fire rate slightly

- Barb/Nettle replicators now regenerate 2 drones every 30 seconds (was: every 60 seconds)

- Increased range at which AI-controlled ships will start firing their drone launchers

- Chalice stat card no longer lies about main projectile damage per shot (was: 1250. actually dealt 500)

- Chalice main projectile damage increased 500 > 750, hitpoints 1500 > 2000

- Chalice charge time reduced 6s > 5s, added 1s chargedown (effective fire rate unchanged and it still fires bolts the entire time)

- Rebalanced Reckoner Autolance Array with a constant, much faster fire rate, with less energy damage per shot and better flux efficiency. 400/240 energy/EMP DPS for 260 flux/sec

- Reckoner targeting paradigm adjusted so that secondary beams now prioritize hitting different targets and prioritize PD duty

- Reckoner secondary beam targeting arc greatly increased (25 degrees > 60 degrees), damage proportion per shot adjusted (50% in main beam, 12.5% per secondary)

- Reckoner damping effect per beam doubled

- Barb/Nettle wings now have real descriptions

- COTL: Removed level 12 mimic lifespan boost - now 45s at all levels

- COTL hard mode is now described in option tooltip as well as on click

- Added a notification after battle and on month end if the player has new upgrades to select

- Added a couple of dialogue options to COTL WS encounter

- The Revenant Host during Haunted finale can no longer use jump points

- Leviathan's Bane warning beam made more visible

- Cavalier (PROX) and Rampart (PROX) supply costs/DP reduced (20 > 18, Explorarium versions are 15)

- Holdout Forgeship is now marked story-critical and can't be destroyed by NPC satbombs

- Holdout no longer has tariffs. Commodities have their price and sale value slightly increased to compensate. Supplies have been hiked to more normal price levels rather than being extremely cheap (sorry). Non-commodities (e.g weapons, ships, special items) are slightly cheaper than previously

- Hallowhall/astropolis colonization points are now granted on HFH event start if player has already done so

- Added alt dialogue for Seraph giving HFH event if Hallowhall is already colonized

- sotf_findsecret and sotf_dev commands now have autocomplete support

- Fixed single-craft Nettle wing appearing in related entries of its weapons

- Fixed duplicated dialogue option with Imoinu Kato during Usurpers Spyglass subquest

- Fixed issue with Revenant Host causing flickering dream VFX during Haunted finale

- Fixed CotL special countermeasure activating in simulator in some circumstances

- Fixed Advanced Countermeasures defensive swarm not being properly cleaned up if nanite officer is removed from the ship but it is not destroyed (e.g when Thrice-Speared abandons a fleeing ship)

- Fixed some unpurple quotes

Version 0.15.0c:

- Chalice secondary bolt damage increased (35/25 kinetic/EMP > 50/40), min DPS 140 > 200, max 240 > 360

- Corrected Chalice description claiming it converted EMP resisted to energy damage: it converts to kinetic

- Chalice secondary bolts now secretly deal HE damage vs Shrouded Dweller hull (this does not save their ***-poor hit strength but it's something?)

- Barb-class Drone Launcher (small): ammo increased 1 > 2

- Tweaks to Thrice-Speared's trashtalk-on-kill during boss fight

- Hatred Beyond Death nanite trait now loses the corpse-fling ability when Fel leaves, even if the "undying rage" part has triggered

- Adaptive nanite swarm: A Trickster's Calling now causes them to use the vanilla missile skill over the daydream one

- Fixed a few typos in Haunted finale

- Fixed cosmetic missing entity error during Haunted lvl 15 dream in random sector

- Fixed Hypnos appearing in places where it really shouldn't

- Fixed Thorn variants not having their OP spent properly

- Fixed Hypnagogic Incursion not lunging proper distance while affected by timeflow bonuses

- Fixed CotL nex custom start not giving the heavy machinery it claims to

Version 0.15.0b:

- Fixed SiC Withering Hex crash

Version 0.15.0a:

- Chalice no longer fires secondary bolts while its ship is phased

- Fixed CotL hard mode not applying its effects

- Fixed Spirit Ward hitpoint max in description being incorrect

- Fixed CotD beam weapon crash when firing at targets with no bounds

Version 0.15:

- Expansion to The Haunted narrative content

- Spookier dreams

- Added a finale quest upon reaching max level

- Dream of somewhere you're meant to be, something you're meant to be, an escape from your torment, an end and a beginning

- Added "Child of the Lake" starting option

- Available as custom start with or without Nexerelin, and as a Nex background

- Unlocked by completing The Haunted finale (or disabling start requirements)

- Trade in your starting skillpoint for an occult technological heirloom who serves you dutifully

- Necromancer gameplay with unique pseudo-aptitude for upgrading your special ability

- Story aspects are very WIP

- Added "Cult of the Daydream" warship technology available as rare drops/blueprints or through COTL start

- Thorn-class heavy attack frigate

- Mercy Multilance, large energy antishield/finisher weapon

- Reckoner Autolance Array, medium energy PD/assault weapon

- Lethargy Autolance, small energy PD

- Chalice Resonance Cage, large synergy suppression weapon

- Barb-class attack drone, available via a LPC and via drone launchers in small and medium missile variety

- Nettle-class assault drone, available via LPC and via drone launcher, large missile

- Adaptive Nanite Swarm invasion proc, ship choice and skill choice RNG are now seeded and cannot be easily savescummed

- Adaptive Nanite Swarm now gains a fixed set of 7
